Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 11  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially concluded the licensing county as Outagamie and identified Brown as a bordering county, recommending Green Bay without explicit and verified confirmation. This led to a premature conclusion without thoroughly validating all possible outcomes. Despite receiving multiple inputs suggesting other border counties like Calumet, the Planner did not solidify its understanding of the full geographic context. The repetition of steps without clarity or cohesive data integration led to a mistaken prioritization without alignment of all gathered geographic data.
